Maya Patel: Heads up — we need a 20m dry run for the client readout (Acme Corp) before next Tue. Focus: onboarding metrics, outstanding enablement tasks, and renewal risk flags.
Evan Kim: I can run slides 1-6 (health + adoption). Will update numbers by EOD.
Ravi Singh: I'll take the integration blockers slide (7) and the outstanding playbook asks. ETA tonight.
Sofia Lopez: I'll cover success stories + CS-led enablement outcomes (slides 8-9). Need updated churn projection from finance.
Maya Patel: @Sofia I'll ping finance. Also flagging two accounts with renewal noise — Acme (high) and Borealis (medium). Need one-liners on risks.
Evan Kim: For Acme — delayed SSO + usage drop in week 3. Proposed mitigation: targeted onboarding session + pager for infra team.
Ravi Singh: Borealis — unclear roles in their team migration. Suggest a gated rollout checklist and extra enablement hours.
Sofia Lopez: Got it. I'll draft risk one-pagers for both. Anyone with recent customer feedback artifacts? paste links
Evan Kim: We have a Loom from last week: https://loom.com/1234 — short clip on SSO blocker.
Maya Patel: OK. Can everyone add action items to this thread by EOD? I'll collate into the slide appendix.
onboarding-bot: Calendar invite created: "Acme QBR dry run" — Tue 10:00 AM. Invitees: Maya, Evan, Ravi, Sofia. (auto)
Ravi Singh: Quick ask — can we do a 10m dress rehearsal for execs after the dry run? Need to vet the one-liners.
Maya Patel: Yes — add 10m at end. I'll prep a 1-slide exec summary with three bullets: health, risk, ask.
Sofia Lopez: +1. Also want to surface two enablement wins as playbook items.
Evan Kim: I'll update slide notes with suggested talking points and fallback lines if infra questions come up.
Maya Patel: Draft action list:
- Evan: update adoption metrics + slide notes
- Ravi: integration blocker slide + checklist
- Sofia: draft risk one-pagers + enablement wins
- Maya: exec summary + collate appendix
Please ping me when done :thumbsup:
Evan Kim: Done — metrics updated (pushed to slides). Sharing link: https://drive.company/acme-qbr
Sofia Lopez: Drafts uploaded to the shared folder, named `Acme_risk_onepagers_v1.pdf`.
Ravi Singh: Checklist in repo: `docs/onboarding/borealis_checklist.md`.
Maya Patel: Great. I'll assemble and run the dry run Tue 10a. If anything blocks earlier, ping #customer-success-urgency.
Sofia Lopez: Thanks team — see you on Tue. :rocket:
